translation.One token sticks to one key, so the upst: One token sticks to one key, so the upstream prompt cache keeps hitting
translation.Decorative highlight painted on the surf: Decorative highlight painted on the surfaces apiduo adds. It is what makes them readable as one family, and it follows the theme colour unless a colour is chosen below.
translation.When off, apiduo surfaces render exactly: When off, apiduo surfaces render exactly like upstream ones.
translation.Adds a bloom around the highlight. Costs: Adds a bloom around the highlight. Costs one filter pass per surface.
translation.This is how every apiduo surface will lo: This is how every apiduo surface will look.
translation.Only lights up under the cursor: Only lights up under the cursor
translation.Tick the models each endpoint accepts. U: Tick the models each endpoint accepts. Unticked combinations produce no route, so the gateway answers 404.
translation.Supported — a route will be generated: Supported — a route will be generated
translation.All-selected endpoints collapse into one: All-selected endpoints collapse into one catch-all route.
translation.Recolours the whole console — buttons, l: Recolours the whole console — buttons, links, charts and the effect together. A colour picked above still wins for the effect itself.
translation.Month and day only, so the same window w: Month and day only, so the same window works every year. Leave both empty to keep it on until you turn it off.
translation.Click a cell to forward it as is or turn: Click a cell to forward it as is or turn it off. Use the arrow to pick a converter.
translation.Converted — the tag names the target pro: Converted — the tag names the target protocol
translation.Derived from the routes above. Nothing h: Derived from the routes above. Nothing here is stored separately.
translation.Endpoint and model combinations that wil: Endpoint and model combinations that will be forwarded
translation.Endpoints that have at least one route: Endpoints that have at least one route
translation.Fill in the channel model list first — t: Fill in the channel model list first — the matrix needs to know which models exist.
translation.Fill in the channel model list to see a: Fill in the channel model list to see a per-model view. Until then the matrix shows endpoint coverage only.
translation.No route is generated, requests get 404: No route is generated, requests get 404
translation.Regex model rules cannot be shown per mo: Regex model rules cannot be shown per model — edit in list view
translation.Its converter cannot serve this endpoint: Its converter cannot serve this endpoint — edit in list view
translation.Two routes claim the same model — edit i: Two routes claim the same model — edit in list view
translation.Forward both image endpoints, pointing e: Forward both image endpoints, pointing edits at generations (Ark and similar merge them).
translation.Clients call /v1/messages, the upstream: Clients call /v1/messages, the upstream speaks OpenAI Chat.
translation.Clients call /v1/chat/completions, the u: Clients call /v1/chat/completions, the upstream speaks Anthropic Messages.
Clients call /v1/chat/completions, the upstream speaks Gemini generateContent.
Clients call /v1/chat/completions, the upstream speaks OpenAI Responses.
translation.Stores the shape of the current routes:: Stores the shape of the current routes: endpoint, converter, upstream path. Model lists are not stored.
translation.Keep this many keys active; the rest sta: Keep this many keys active; the rest stay on standby and step in when one is disabled. 0 keeps every key active.
translation.This row was written when the request se: This row was written when the request settled — async task settlement, a channel test, or a fee adjustment. Nothing in that path hands a prompt to the gateway, so there is no body to show; the cost and tokens above are the whole record.
translation.Metadata sampling kept the span but cont: Metadata sampling kept the span but content sampling stripped the body. Raise the content rate in System Settings → Observability if you need prompts for this model.
translation.Where traces are written and where the l: Where traces are written and where the log drawer links to. Leave a field empty to keep following the deployment environment — the greyed text is what is running right now. Saving a new export endpoint takes effect on the next batch, no restart.
translation.Base URL only — spans are POSTed to {hos: Base URL only — spans are POSTed to {host}/api/public/otel/v1/traces. An internal container name is fine and usually faster.
translation.What the \"Langfuse\" button in the log: What the "Langfuse" button in the log drawer opens. Only needed when the export endpoint is reachable from the gateway but not from a browser.
translation.Confirm the token and network first; fou: Confirm the token and network first; four tool names should come back:
translation.— the token is missing or dead. Check th: — the token is missing or dead. Check the space after Bearer.
translation.— available models and their parameter c: — available models and their parameter constraints
translation.— generate images with reference images,: — generate images with reference images, aspect ratio and resolution
translation.— submit a video job and get a task_id i: — submit a video job and get a task_id immediately
translation.— poll a job status and its artifact URL: — poll a job status and its artifact URLs
translation.Has an IP allowlist, external clients wi: Has an IP allowlist, external clients will be blocked
This account has no tokens yet.
translation.No expiry, no quota cap, no IP allowlist: No expiry, no quota cap, no IP allowlist.
translation.— the caller sent no Accept header. curl: — the caller sent no Accept header. curl sends */* by default so it passes; other tools must set Accept: application/json, text/event-stream.
translation.— it is an old SSE client: it GETs /mcp,: — it is an old SSE client: it GETs /mcp, gets 405 and retries. This server only takes POST with Accept: application/json, text/event-stream; switch the transport to Streamable HTTP, or bridge it with mcp-remote.
translation.— the error text comes back verbatim. Mo: — the error text comes back verbatim. Most often: no enabled model in the capability registry (models.list returns 0), no quota or a model allowlist on the token, or a parameter outside what the model declares — that one is rejected locally and never billed.
translation.Pick a client, then drop the fields belo: Pick a client, then drop the fields below into its MCP settings. The token sits in the Authorization header itself — click it to switch. Clients that read a config file keep theirs under the JSON block.
translation.Not pinned yet: the value above is deriv: Not pinned yet: the value above is derived from the route table. Typing here pins it for this channel.
translation.The same fields are editable in the Forw: The same fields are editable in the Forwarding Routes tab.
translation.Image-to-image switches to the edit endp: Image-to-image switches to the edit endpoint and is encoded as multipart files.
translation.Image-to-image stays on the same endpoin: Image-to-image stays on the same endpoint; image references travel in the JSON body and mask is not forwarded.
translation.Every entry keeps its own upstream in th: Every entry keeps its own upstream in the route table and requests are forwarded unchanged — the same behaviour as new-api. Turn the switch on to declare one address for all of them.
translation.Fold image entries into one canonical re: Fold image entries into one canonical request before sending.
Nothing is folded while this is off.
translation.Off: every entry forwards on its own rou: Off: every entry forwards on its own route, exactly like new-api.
translation.Primary endpoint must be a path starting: Primary endpoint must be a path starting with /.
translation.Responses keeps its own route. With the: Responses keeps its own route. With the image protocol on, chat entries are converted into image tasks, so keep that channel image-only.
translation.This endpoint is not an image path, so t: This endpoint is not an image path, so the protocol keeps folding image entries to /v1/images/generations; the other entries still forward here.
translation.This path does not end with generations,: This path does not end with generations, so image requests will not land where the protocol expects.
translation.The image protocol picks the endpoint it: The image protocol picks the endpoint itself; this entry does not use its own upstream.
translation.The shared landing address for every ent: The shared landing address for every entry. A single entry can still point somewhere else.
translation.Click to give this entry its own upstrea: Click to give this entry its own upstream.
translation.How does the upstream take image-to-imag: How does the upstream take image-to-image?
translation.Image references stay in the JSON body;: Image references stay in the JSON body; mask is not forwarded.
Image and mask are uploaded as files.
translation.Left empty, the last segment of the prim: Left empty, the last segment of the primary endpoint is swapped from generations to edits. Fill it in only when the upstream path differs.
translation.Open the protocol details to change how: Open the protocol details to change how image-to-image reaches the upstream.
translation.Text to image / Image to image: Text to image / Image to image
translation.Converted into an image task; with an im: Converted into an image task; with an image it takes the image-to-image line
translation.How does the primary endpoint land upstr: How does the primary endpoint land upstream?
translation.Downstream entries only talk to this end: Downstream entries only talk to this endpoint; however many endpoints the upstream has, they all converge here.
translation.Turned into an image task, then converge: Turned into an image task, then converges to the primary endpoint
translation.Not intercepted; keeps its own landing: Not intercepted; keeps its own landing
translation.However many endpoints the upstream has,: However many endpoints the upstream has, they all converge here; every downstream entry is converted from it.
translation.Turned into an image task, then converte: Turned into an image task, then converted from the primary endpoint
translation.Off means forwarding only: chat entries: Off means forwarding only: chat entries no longer return a chat.completion, and every entry goes out on its own route with the body untouched.
translation.Image protocol is off: the entries below: Image protocol is off: the entries below forward on their own routes, unchanged.
translation.This channel only declares image models: This channel only declares image models ({{models}}).
translation.Set up as an image channel: Set up as an image channel
translation.Fills in a primary endpoint and one upst: Fills in a primary endpoint and one upstream path; both stay editable.
